title: ADE plugin registry index
description: The document the crawler writes and every ADE install reads. Kept in step with apps/desktop/src/shared/plugins/registryIndex.ts, which is the enforcing copy — this file documents the contract and lets the crawler validate before publishing.

version.description: Index shape version. Readers accept a higher number and degrade field by field rather than refusing the document.

generatedAt.description: When the crawler produced this document.

pluginId.description: Lowercase kebab-case. Also a directory name, a secret namespace, a sync primary key and a CLI word.

httpsUrl.description: https only, and no credentials in the authority — an entry is third-party text and these URLs reach git.

description.description: One line. Longer text belongs in the readme.

repo.description: Canonical repository URL — where the crawler found the plugin.

source.description: Installable source, when it differs from repo. Readers fall back to repo.

official.description: Curated by ADE. Set from official.json, never from the plugin's own manifest.

featured.description: Set from featured.json. The hero row is curated, not computed.

surfaces.description: Core surfaces the plugin extends. Facet metadata; the installed manifest stays authoritative.

adds.description: Short lines for the install modal when the entry publishes no manifest.

installs.description: Distinct machines that reported installing this plugin. Omit when never measured — readers render an omitted count as nothing, never as zero.

checksums.description: version -> sha256 over the plugin's source tree. Published for official entries; the installer refuses a mismatch.
